features: 【⌨️ Ultra-Slim Portable Design】 Designed for productivity on the go, the Acer Nano Pad Slim features a sleek and lightweight profile that easily fits into backpacks, laptop bags, and workspaces. Perfect for professionals, students, and travelers seeking a clutter-free setup.

【🌈 Adjustable RGB Backlit Keys】 Enhance your typing experience with vibrant multi-color LED backlighting. Easily switch between different backlight colors and adjust brightness levels according to your environment, making it ideal for day and night productivity.

【🔗 Bluetooth 5.0 Multi-Device Connectivity】 Equipped with stable Bluetooth 5.0 technology, the keyboard offers seamless wireless connectivity up to 10 meters. Compatible with Windows, Android, iOS, Mac OS, tablets, smartphones, laptops, and desktops for effortless cross-platform usage.

【🔋 420mAh Rechargeable Battery】 Powered by a built-in 420mAh lithium-polymer rechargeable battery, the keyboard delivers long-lasting performance with intelligent power-saving technology. Auto-sleep mode helps extend battery life while Type-C charging ensures convenient recharging.

【⚡ Comfortable & Efficient Typing Experience】 Engineered with responsive keys rated for over 3 million keystrokes, the Nano Pad Slim provides smooth and accurate typing. Dedicated system switching for Windows, Android, and iOS enables optimized shortcuts and improved workflow efficiency.
